description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AuthorizationException' used within the OrangeHRM system for authorization-related errors. It provides static methods to instantiate exceptions with specific messages when an entity or method is not supported or implemented.

classes.name: AuthorizationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for authorization errors, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions for unsupported or unimplemented entities and methods.

methods.name: entityNotSupported
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not supported, used for signaling unsupported entities.

methods.name: entityNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type's functionality is not implemented.

methods.name: methodNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific method is not implemented.
